query: Which positive control agent(s) and exact doses will be used as benchmarks (e.g., aspirin vs enoxaparin), and how will vehicle and sham groups be defined and justified?

response.query: Which positive control agent(s) and exact doses will be used as benchmarks (e.g., aspirin vs enoxaparin), and how will vehicle and sham groups be defined and justified?
response.answer: Enoxaparin is a positive control benchmark, typically at 1 mg/kg, while vehicle and sham groups use saline and placebo treatments respectively.
